Cupcake sex pest

By: Joy Summers | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Explosive revelations from inside a company in Naboomspruit that makes colours for the baking industry. Rolkem supplies glitter, Luminous colours locally and internationally, but many of these product

Unique Selling Point:
This is a multi layered story with fantastic case studies who have both visual and documentary evidence

Summary:
But the duping of consumers is only part of this story, because the man who owns Rolkem, Andries Kemp is at the centre of serious allegations of sexual, physical assault and verbal abuse of his staff, insurance fraud, and failure to pay over UIF and SARS payments.

Now at least 8 former employees, who have evidence of all their allegations including footage and documents have decided enough is enough and will tell their stories to Carte Blanche.


Further information:
More information
Jason van Eeden was only fifteen when he began working at Rolkem in 2019. According to the staff, Andries Kemp employees young white boys from poor families who have little bargaining power. Jason was exactly that- raised by his single mother who is a bar tender, he needed extra money. Although they are employed by the company, Andries Kemp uses them at his huge home in Naboomspruit Golf Park to do maintenance and look after his father who is infirm. He insists they watch him in the shower in the morning and tries to get them to shower with him. He makes them stay over ( case study Andre) – there are no keys on the bedroom door and Kemp just comes in and climbs into their beds with them. For Jason – it began with a hair cut. Kemp insisted he cut Jason’s hair and that Jason needed to strip down to a towel. Once he had finished cutting Jason’s hair he pulled off the towel and as Jason explains he sexually molested him. Jason says he felt cemented to the floor. The abuse went on for several years. Jason says he tried to push the bar fridge against the door but Kemp would just push harder and open the door. Kemp used any refusals as leverage against him.
He has never told his story, but now that he has left he is determined that Kemp will not do this to others and he wants to tell his story on camera.
He is not alone we have Dawie who will tell us how he pushed him against the wall , how he insisted Dawie shave his back and his front and would phone him at night and try and have sex talks with him. Dawie was at Rolkem in 2024 for about 4 months. Then there is Andre who has left and tried to open a case against him, but the local police told him that Kemp bribes the cops and so they refuse to open cases against him. Andre has footage of Kemp coming into his room naked, because Andre set up the camera system.

Jaroldine and Mark have all the evidence of the toxic chemicals and the SARS and UIF and Insurance fraud. Jaroldine only resigned in June this year after working for Kemp since 2018/ 2019. Heindrich won a case against him and is also prepared to go on camera.

VO 15 Our insiders dispute this and say Rolkem does not supply colours for cars and arts and crafts Lou Andries we spoke to people that said they went to Delta colours to pick up products that was brought back here, put into little containers and sold as food colouring? Lourensa up sound in office You only have to show us the most recent one VO 17 There are FDA registration numbers on the Rolkem products. The FDA is the United States Food & Drug Administration. Heindrich I personally handled the registration for this. The registration is only to show that you are a manufacturer that sends products to the United States. It means nothing in terms of whether its edible or not. Andries Kemp in office There are certificates to show that its ‘FD & C’ safe, but it’s done globally for a series of their colours. Lou Ok but where does it say that it is food safe? Andries No, no. Not on this certificate. Lou So this just says what the ingredients are.
